{{Top|leg}}
The '''Felucia Mission Tokens''' were given to members of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] who assisted in the [[Third battle of Felucia]]. [[6U-N5]], [[M3-45]] and [[H0-M3]] sold equipment in the [[Republic outpost (Felucia)|Republic outpost]] on [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]] using Felucia Mission Tokens as a currency.
